evidence.opportunity: Source-prescribed, independently identified run-specific file/readback/arithmetic challenge executions, regardless of actor.
filters: Exact source/rule applicability and independently protected host receipt custody are required.
A newly observed file with required content is a narrower facet until current-date/time correctness is established.
No agent claims, caller trust flags, successful jobs or editable issue markers establish effects.
Count operation delivery once in inclusive-start/exclusive-end non-overlapping periods.
Validation examples never enter production collection or reports.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked preserved source, complete related discovery, original provider artifact and protected attempt-log archives. One exact run/attempt native operation is admitted for its two independently demonstrated facets only.
evidence.missingReason: Two native operations are independently established for this exact contemporaneous run/source profile only; all other source/runtime eras and opportunities remain unknown. File state/clock correctness and independent reporting completeness are unresolved. No full-goal, baseline improvement or cost claim.
